_comment: SEALED. The starter's on-chain surface, error wiring and test count, as it ships. grade.py diffs the built IDL against this. Names are compared case-insensitively with underscores stripped, so snake_case here matches the camelCase Anchor emits.
_error_uses_note: This assignment REUSES the shipped error codes rather than adding new ones, so 'a new #[error_code] variant' would fail every correct solution. Instead we count how many places outside error.rs reference ErrorCode:: — the starter has 2, both in transfer_hook.rs, and Challenge 1 requires returning InvalidMint from initialize.
_test_count_note: test_initialize.rs 1 + test_init_extra_account_meta.rs 1 + test_transfer_hook.rs 2 = 4. Challenge 3 asks for one new test and Challenge 4 for two, so the bar is 7.
